members.name: color
members.doc: The color to show, as a valid CSS color string. Its alpha is kept.

members.name: secondaryColor
members.doc: A second color. With it the swatch shows a diagonal two-tone preview, and both colors keep their alpha. It needs a color.

members.name: shape
members.doc: The swatch outline: `square` keeps the token-based corner radius, and `circle` is round.

members.name: colorName
members.doc: One short phrase that names the whole preview in the application's language. Without one, a single color is named by its own description and a two-tone swatch by both descriptions.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Marks the swatch disabled. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.
